add-to-phone.title: Add This Guide To Your Phone

items.title: Add This Guide To Your Phone
items.html:
When you first access this guidebook on your phone, you'll notice a prompt to add it to your home screen. This is highly recommended because it makes the guide faster and easier to access. And it remains accessible offline.

Following the prompt will add an app icon to your phone. It's just like any other app, but without you needing to download anything or sign in!

Doing this means that every time you want to access the guide, you just need to tap the app instead of searching for the link in your inbox - much easier!

Adding the app if you’re an Apple user

If you have an Apple device, the "Add to Home Screen" option won’t appear for you unless you’re using Safari browser. Don’t worry, this is really simple to solve - just copy the guidebook link and paste it into Safari. From there, you can follow the prompts to add the guidebook to your home screen.

Always get the latest version of the guidebook

Our guidebook is regularly updated with information designed to help you get the most out of your stay. To avoid missing out on any of these updates, the app automatically updates every 24 hours. If you want to get the updates sooner, just refresh the screen every time you open the guidebook from your home screen - this way you’ll always get the latest version. To refresh the app, swipe the app closed, and tap the app icon again to fully reload.

Share your guide with your group

You can send the link to this guidebook to everyone who’s travelling with you. That way, everyone has access to all the information they’ll need (which means less hassle for the trip organizer!).

items.title: Welcome to Grace and Ember!
items.html:
Welcome to Grace and Ember!
Here at your fingertips is everything you should need for your stay with us, from planning your time before departure straight through checkout. In this easy-to-navigate link, you will find information about the cabin, ideas of things to do in the area, our Wi-Fi login credentials, and so much more.

In order to best enjoy your time in our home, we encourage you to add this "app" to your phone. All of the content will even be accessible when your phone is offline.

* It's not really an "app", but more a tool for easy access on your home screen

  • For iPhone:
    • Tap the square with arrow pointing up at the bottom of your screen
    • Select "Add to Home Screen"
  • For Android:
    • Tap "Add to Home Screen" where prompted when first accessing the site

Print or Save a PDF
If you would like to print certain pages ahead of traveling, or if you'd like to save a PDF to your device, just tap the print button above. It won't print right away, but will create a PDF which you can save or print.

Contacting Us
We pride ourselves on swiftly meeting guest needs. We can be reached as follows:

  • Preferred: Airbnb or VRBO message
  • Phone: 404-358-1552 (emergencies)
  • Instagram: @Bk_stays
  • Facebook: BK Stays

What Next?
Please relax, unwind, have fun, and enjoy your stay!

items.title: 4:00 PM Check-in
items.html:
If you would like an early check-in, please see our Early Check In (Half Day Stay Option) section

Otherwise - 4:00 PM is a strict check-in time. If you are arriving early, take a look at the Local Recommendation section. We've listed a few things to do around the area while we prepare the home!

items.title: Early Check In (Half Day Stay Option)
items.html:
Want to get here early? Add a Half Day Stay and you can arrive as early as 8:00 AM on your arrival day.

We reserve the rest of that day just for you at a discounted rate, as long as the home is available. Send us a message and we'll check the calendar and send you the price.

Without a Half Day Stay, we usually can't offer early check-in because of our tight cleaning and maintenance schedule.

items.title: 10:00 AM Check-out
items.html:
If you would like a late check-out, please see our Late Check Out (Half Day Stay Option) section

Otherwise - 10:00 AM is a strict check-out time.

items.title: Late Check Out (Half Day Stay Option)
items.html:
Not ready to leave? Add a Half Day Stay and you won't need to check out until 8:00 PM on your departure day.

We reserve the rest of that day just for you at a discounted rate, as long as the home is available. Send us a message and we'll check the calendar and send you the price.

Without a Half Day Stay, we usually can't offer late check-out because of our tight cleaning and maintenance schedule.

items.title: Extended Stay?
items.html: Would you like to add another night? If we have availability the day before or after your reservation, we would love to offer you that extra night at a great discount. We'll even cover the taxes and fees! Just let us know if your travel plans are flexible and we will make sure to accommodate the changes!

items.title: Check-out Process
items.html:
Standard check-out is at 10:00 AM on your departure date (Unless you've paid for a late check-out).

When you've concluded your stay, technically, you can just leave no questions asked lol :) But, if you really wanted to give our cleaning team some love - we would appreciate it if you would take care of a few simple things:

  • Dishwasher - load and start the dishwasher
  • Trash - No Loose Trash Please - remove the trash, place it in the black can(s)
  • Towels - place used towels in the shower
  • Lock-Up - ensure all doors are locked

We hope you had a wonderful stay and wish you safe travels back home!

items.title: Lost and Found
items.html:
Please triple-check the home before departing to ensure you have not left anything behind. Common items left behind include phone chargers, computer cords, passports/licenses, clothes, electronics, eyeglasses, toiletries/makeup, documents, and toys.

Please send a message the moment you realize you've left something behind.

We completely understand that things can get left behind — and we’re more than happy to help get your items back to you! We’ll gladly ship your lost item using the postal service or carrier of your choice (standard, express, or overnight).

We kindly ask for the shipping cost, plus a $20 service fee to cover the time and materials for packaging and handling. Be certain to include:

  • Item description
  • Where you think you may have left the item
  • The name on the reservation

Just let us know how you’d like it sent, and we’ll take care of the rest!

items.title: Cancellation Policy
items.html:
Our cancellation policy varies depending on the time and platform you booked on (VRBO, Airbnb, Direct etc). Your home has a designated cancellation policy, which would have been clearly stated at the time of booking and may fall under one of the following categories: strict, firm, moderate, or flexible.

We strongly recommend that you secure travel insurance to protect your investment. If you have purchased travel insurance, please consult your provider for assistance with cancellations or disruptions.

If travel insurance was not purchased, cancellations will be handled under the cancellation terms outlined in your reservation. However, exceptions may be made under the following circumstances:

  • A governor-issued state of emergency directly impacting the area or
  • A mandatory evacuation order issued for the specific county where the property is located.

These exceptions typically apply in cases of severe weather, such as hurricanes, significant snowstorms, or other government-declared emergencies.

items.title: Thank You For Staying With Us
items.html:
Thank you for staying with us, and we hope you enjoyed your stay. If you are unable to leave us 5 stars, please don't hesitate to contact us first to let us know why - you are key to helping our next guests to have a wonderful time.

We love online reviews!

Vrbo and Airbnb automatically sends you a review request. All you need to do is click the "leave a review" button, give us a star rating, and write a sentence or two about what you liked the best during your stay. Was it the comfy beds; the local information and recommendations; or perhaps the location and all the fun activities to do at the home?


Thank you!

Brandon and Katharina

The service is provided for your enjoyment but you are responsible for safe and appropriate use and complying with all laws. If there is any loss of service please contact us.

items.title: Propane Grill
items.html:
There is a propane grill for your personal use on the back patio. Please follow the grill instructions carefully when using propane. Do not forget to close the valve when you're done!

We always try to keep a full tank on site - but sometimes they run out before we can get a replacement there. If you run out and need a replacement, we can try and get you a replacement delivered - but - depending on timing - it may be faster for you to run and exchange the empty.

Of course we will reimburse you for the tank and your time!

items.title: Propane Tank(s)
items.html:
We TRY to keep a full propane tank (and an extra one) at the home. Most of the time we can get them swapped out before check in. Unfortunately, that's not always possible. We apologize if you did not find a full propane tank upon arrival!

We can try and coordinate another person to deliver you a new tank, but their availability might not be immediate. If you need something quick, we recommend running to the store and exchanging the empty one(s) or a new one - and yes of course we would be happy to reimburse you for the tank and your trouble! Just let us know. Thank You.

items.title: Hot Tub / Jacuzzi
items.html:
Please Be Patient and Conscious When Using Jacuzzi Controls.

Do not push too many buttons at once or too often - this will put the Jacuzzi into Sleep Mode and It Will Not Heat!

Upon your arrival, the jacuzzi might* have a slightly lowered temperature and it may take a moment to heat up.

Simply raise the temperature by using the arrow up buttons until the screen shows a different temperature.

We recommend an ideal temperature of 102*F.

Jacuzzi Video

items.title: Cards, Games + More
items.html:
We try to keep a great selection of puzzles, books, board games, and card games for the whole family.

If something is missing or broken, PLEASE LET US KNOW immediately so we can order a replacement.

Feel Free to Help Yourself, But...

Please keep everything neat and tidy for the next guests as well :)

Missing puzzle pieces or having only half the chess pieces isn't fun for anyone!

items.title: Kitchen + Supplies + Appliances
items.html: We have a fully stocked kitchen with a stainless steel appliance package. We try to provide everything you may need, but we're not perfect. If you have ANY suggestions for small appliances, dishware, flatware, glassware, or even dry goods that would be beneficial - let us know! We would be happy to see if it's possible to place an Amazon/Walmart/Grocery delivery order for you during your stay :)

items.title: Laundry
items.html: We do have a private washer and dryer located in the home. There should be a supply of detergent for your use. To operate the machines, simply select the program you want, place the detergent in, close the door, and hit start.

items.title: Age Requirement
items.html: The minimum age requirement to book is 25 years of age. The home is child friendly, but not childproof, and may not be suitable for infants or children without adult supervision.

items.title: Confetti / Glitter
items.html:
No Confetti or Glitter
We understand that special occasions call for celebration - and sometimes decorations! However, confetti and glitter are extremely difficult to clean and can cause damage to furniture and floors. Any evidence of confetti or glitter left behind will incur additional cleaning fees. Please celebrate responsibly and help us keep the home in great condition - no confetti or glitter, please.

items.title: Damages
items.html: Guests are financially responsible for any damage, theft, missing items, or violations of house rules during their stay. You could be charged for: Property damage or theft; Unauthorized pets; Excessive cleaning or evidence of smoking; Exceeding occupancy or parking limits; Any other violations outlined in this agreement. You will be notified in writing if any damage is found. Major damage that delays the next check-in may result in additional charges for guest relocation or compensation. Please report any existing damage at check-in, and notify us right away if anything breaks or is damaged during your stay, even if it’s small. We understand accidents happen and can often replace or repair items quickly if we're informed. Guests are responsible for damage caused by misuse or negligence.

items.title: Fire Safety and Prevention
items.html:
Guest agrees to comply with all local, county, and state fire restrictions, including any active burn bans or official fire safety regulations. Guest is responsible for helping maintain a fire-safe environment throughout their stay. This includes, but is not limited to; Ensuring that all outdoor fires (e.g., bonfires or fire pits) are fully extinguished after use, before going to bed, and before vacating the property; Never leaving open flames or burning embers unattended; Using only designated fire areas and keeping all fires small, controlled, and manageable; Ensuring fire extinguishers located in the home are accessible at all times and used in case of fire emergencies.

Additionally, Guest(s) acknowledges that outdoor grills must be cleaned and properly maintained after each use to prevent fire hazards. Guest agrees to: Clean the grill thoroughly after each use; Remove all grease and dispose of it safely in the trash (never on the ground or around the property); Ensure the grill is turned off, left in safe, clean, and operable condition, and covered if applicable; Keep a fire extinguisher nearby when using the grill.

Failure to follow fire safety guidelines may result in fines, eviction, or financial liability for any resulting damages.

items.title: Occupancy - Max 6 Persons (Age 2+)
items.html: We try not to overcrowd our home. The maximum guest limit is 6 persons unless otherwise approved. Please reach out prior to arrival if you have any additional capacity requests.

items.title: Reservation Adjustments
items.html: If you need to make any change in your stay, for example, regarding the number of guests, bringing a service animal or anything at all, please let us know ahead of time so we can accommodate you. However, if you do not disclose any changes, like an animal or extra guests (above max occupancy) you could be subject to a reservtion cancellation without refund.

items.title: Security Camera
items.html: Guests acknowledge and accept there are cameras located on the exterior of the property. Guests hereby acknowledge that the cameras location records video directly in front of the front entrance door and leading to the parking area, and this constitutes a public area. Guests understand that video may be captured, and no conversations located within this area may be deemed confidential. The intent of this camera is not to infringe on the privacy of Guests, but to serve as a safety and security measure.

items.title: Septic and Plumbing
items.html:
Please ONLY PUT TOILET PAPER in the toilet and throw the remaining in the trash!

Tampons, baby wipes, paper towels, or anything other than toilet paper in the toilet will clog the drain/tank. This can result in clogged toilets, and septic damage and will result in damage fees.

items.title: Smoking
items.html: We have a strict No Smoking Policy. Smoking is not allowed on the property in any form. This includes, but is not limited to marijuana, pipes, cigars, cigarettes, vaping, e-cigs, etc. If our cleaners or cameras report evidence of smoking you will be charged a 500$ smoke remediation fine.

items.title: TV's + Streaming
items.html:
We have Hi-Speed WIFI for all of your streaming needs!

There are Smart TV's throughout the entire home.

Go to the TV Home Screen

Search For (or Download) The Channel App You Want To Watch & Login to your TV Provider.

Please don't hesitate to reach out if you need provider login assistance!

items.title: Heating / Cooling
items.html: There is a smart thermostat on the wall that allows you to control the temperature of the home. When you arrive, the thermostat should be set to keep the temperature between 70-74*F - but you can adjust if you need. If you're running the air conditioning or heating - PLEASE keep all windows and outside doors closed to ensure it operates at maximum efficiency. We recommend a setting of about 72*F which we find keeps the place at a comfortable temperature.
